title: Budget samples before selecting hardware
description: Change the signal profile, transport, frame window, retained payload, processing time, and deadline. Watch throughput, link pressure, and end-to-end decision age move together.
modelNote: Teaching fixture only. Profiles and limits are illustrative architecture inputs, not device specifications, clinical targets, or efficacy evidence.

profiles.label: External surface fixture
profiles.detail: Moderate channel count and sample rate for aggregate field signals.

profiles.label: Cortical field fixture
profiles.detail: Higher channel density with a moderate-bandwidth field-signal path.

profiles.label: Microelectrode fixture
profiles.detail: High-rate channels that pressure transport and edge processing.

transports.label: Constrained wireless link
transports.detail: Limited effective payload capacity with a larger delay allowance.

transports.label: Local edge bridge
transports.detail: A bounded local transport between acquisition and an edge processor.

transports.label: High-capacity wired path
transports.detail: An illustrative wired path with high payload capacity and low delay.
